While searching in Burp for the Server: .*, it returned the desired information, but I still had to sift through each request.

resources.name: BCheck Helper
resources.desc: BCheck Helper makes finding and importing BChecks scripts into Burp easier by loading them from either a remote GitHub or local Git repository.
